app.name: VenuBoard
app.tagline: Modular websites and management for venues

status.notEntitled: Not included in this venue’s plan

home.title: Application scaffold
home.description: This is the VenuBoard application shell. Routing, layout, internationalisation, environment handling, authentication, invitations, onboarding and the staff presence module are in place. Remaining product modules are later work.
home.surfacesDescription: The three documented surfaces exist as labelled routes. Venue administration and platform administration require a signed-in identity with the right membership or platform role.
home.nextStep: The staff presence and events calendar modules are in place. Feed, bookings, offers and atmosphere remain later work.

publicVenue.title: Public venue site
publicVenue.unavailableBody: This venue is not on the public site.
publicVenue.adultNoticeBody: This venue is classified as adult nightlife. The 18+ notice is independent of the staff module and is not legal advice.

admin.title: Venue administration
admin.intro: Select a venue you are authorised for, then open the staff presence or events module. Controls are hidden when you lack the matching action; the database still enforces every write.
admin.staffModuleHelp: Who is on the floor right now.

staffPublic.empty: No staff are listed right now.

staffAdmin.title: Staff presence
staffAdmin.intro: Private records stay off the public site. Presence is a promotional in/not-in indicator, not attendance or payroll. A manager-recorded consent is an operational record, not legal proof.
staffAdmin.noAccess: You do not have a staff action in this venue.
staffAdmin.moduleSettingsHelp: Presence expiry is a temporary bounded duration until opening-hours integration exists. Avatar upload is deferred.
staffAdmin.showAll: Show all published profiles with status
staffAdmin.privatePublicSplit: Internal name is private. Public name, title and bio are what customers can see after consent and publication.
staffAdmin.internalHint: Never shown on the public site.
staffAdmin.confirmBulk: I confirm bulk marking everyone not present at this venue only
staffAdmin.confirmDeactivate: I confirm deactivation. Public display will stop and presence will reset.
staffAdmin.confirmRestore: I confirm restoration. Profiles stay unpublished and not present.
staffAdmin.forbidden: You do not have permission for that action.
staffAdmin.invalidPayload: Check the fields and try again.
staffAdmin.notFound: That staff record was not found.
staffAdmin.inactive: That staff record is not active.
staffAdmin.stateNotEntitled: Not included in this venue’s plan

eventsAdmin.title: Events
eventsAdmin.intro: Create and manage events for this venue. Drafts are private until published. The database enforces every permission.
eventsAdmin.noAccess: You do not have an events action in this venue.
eventsAdmin.stateNotEntitled: Not included in this venue’s plan
eventsAdmin.posterDeferred: Poster image upload is deferred. You may note a storage path placeholder.
eventsAdmin.forbidden: You do not have permission for that.
eventsAdmin.conflict: This action conflicts with the current state.
eventsAdmin.approvalRequired: This venue requires manager approval before publishing.

platform.title: VenuBoard platform administration
platform.supportBody: Platform support can open this surface, but creating businesses, venues, trials or owner invitations requires a platform administrator with manage_platform_tenants. Support sessions cannot substitute for that authority.
platform.listLimit: Showing at most {limit} venues. This list is bounded and does not load every tenant.
platform.empty: No venues are visible yet. Onboard a business to create the first unpublished venue.

onboarding.title: Onboard a business and first venue
onboarding.description: This creates the business, unpublished first venue, trial entitlements, branding and a business-owner invitation in one database transaction. No production email is sent.

fields.classificationLocked: Lock classification so the venue cannot lower it

hints.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens. The database is the final check.
hints.timezone: IANA identifier. Asia/Bangkok is the default and can be changed.
hints.classification: Choose deliberately. Do not infer this from the name or branding. adult_nightlife is stored as nightlife_18_plus and will later require an 18+ notice.
hints.notLegalAdvice: An 18+ notice does not prove compliance with Thai law. Legal review remains an unresolved launch blocker.
hints.contrast: Text and background contrast is below WCAG 4.5:1. You can continue, but check readability.
hints.font: Only the system font fallback is available (OQ-27).
hints.mediaDeferred: Logo and background image uploads are deferred. These fields are not pretending to store files.
hints.trial: The standard trial is 30 days and includes every available MVP module unless you exclude one. core_profile cannot be excluded.
hints.noPrices: No prices, invoices or payment records are created (OQ-05).

classification.adult_nightlife: Adult nightlife (18+ notice when later published)

review.unpublished: This venue will be created unpublished (draft). It will not appear on the public site until an operator publishes it.
